## [[typst INVOICE]{.honk}](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-invoice/)

::: {.panel-tabset}


### Install {{< iconify icon-park-twotone:install >}}

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="40%"}

:::

::: {.column width="60%"}

+ from a [`Project` directory](https://martinctc.github.io/blog/rstudio-projects-and-working-directories-a-beginner%27s-guide/)
+ navigate to [terminal](https://docs.posit.co/ide/user/ide/guide/tools/terminal.html)
+ paste the `quarto` command:

```bash 
quarto use template mcanouil/quarto-invoice@2.0.2
```
:::

:::

![](https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExd3AwMGxmZTNpdW55cmhhZGk5bm1ldHcyajUxZm91NzU4b3BzYWRwMCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/0Bgb5HhG5HXO0dbE3X/giphy.gif){.absolute left="-20" bottom="10" height="400"}

### Script {{< iconify streamline-color:script-2-flat >}}

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

Elaborate:

```{r}
---
title: Consulting 2026
description: 2026/01/01 -- 2026/12/31
sender:
  name: Firstname LASTNAME
  email: Firstname.LASTNAME@company.dev
  address:
    street: 123 Rue de la Paix
    zip: 75000
    city: Paris
    country: France
  registration: 123 456 789
  vat: FR1234567890
  exempted: "Exempted from VAT (article 259-1 du CGI, France)."
invoice:
  number: 2026-001
  issued: 2026-01-01
  due: 2026-01-31
  reference: abcd1234
  fee: 2.28
  penalty: 40
  currency: EUR
  items:
    - description: A very important deliverable
      details: A description of the tasks.
      quantity: 1
      unit-price: 12345.67
      vat: 0
bank:
  bic: AZERTYUI
  iban: FR12 1234 4567 7890 1234 5678 901
recipient:
  name: Company, Inc.
  address:
    street: 123 Main Street
    zip: 12345
    city: New York
    state: NY
    country: United States
format:
  invoice-typst:
    output-file: index
    lang: en
    region: UK
    papersize: a4
    margin:
      x: 2.5cm
      y: 2.5cm
brand:
  typography:
    fonts:
      - family: Alegreya Sans
        source: google
        weight: [400, 700]
        style: [normal, italic]
    base:
      family: "Alegreya Sans"
      size: 12pt
    headings:
      color: dodgerblue
---
```

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

Simplified:

```{r}
format:
  invoice-typst:
    sender:
      name: "Example Consulting Ltd"
    recipient:
      name: "Director Doe & Co"
    invoice:
      number: "INV-2026-001"
      issued: 2026-05-01
      due: 2026-05-31
      currency: GBP
      reference: "ACME-2026-001"
      items:
        - description: Strategy workshop
          quantity: 2
          unit-price: 1500
          vat: 20
    bank:
      bic: "EXAMPGB2L"
      iban: "GB00 EXAM 0000 0000 0000 00"
```


:::

## [[{{< iconify material-icon-theme:quarto >}} Quarto 1.10]{.quarto .Bigger}](https://opensource.posit.co/blog/2026-08-03_quarto-1-10/)

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="35%"}

[{{< iconify material-icon-theme:quarto >}} < 1.10:]{.quarto .Bigger}

+ axe-core checks
+ shortcodes
+ pdf fonts
+ typst fonts

:::

::: {.column width="65%"}

[[{{< iconify material-icon-theme:quarto >}} = 1.10:]{.quarto .Bigger}](https://opensource.posit.co/blog/2026-08-03_quarto-1-10/#other-important-fixes)

+ [clearer report](https://opensource.posit.co/blog/2026-08-03_quarto-1-10/#accessibility-checking-improvements)
+ operative [***within equations***](https://jtkulas.github.io/LiveStreams/slides/2026/8_18_26/shortcodes)
+ [`LuaLaTeX`](https://quarto.org/docs/output-formats/pdf-basics.html#fonts) less likely to crash
+ further css {{< iconify icomoon-free:arrow-left flip=horizontal >}} typst integration & refinement

:::
